dish.title: Classic Smash Burgers with Special Sauce
dish.description: Double smash burgers: loose balls of 80/20 ground chuck pressed thin onto a ripping-hot cast-iron skillet for lacy, deeply browned edges, stacked with melted American cheese on butter-toasted sesame buns with a tangy pickle special sauce, dill pickles, paper-thin onion, and shredded iceberg.

recipe_version.title: Classic Smash Burgers with Special Sauce
recipe_version.description: Double smash burgers: loose balls of 80/20 ground chuck pressed thin onto a ripping-hot cast-iron skillet for lacy, deeply browned edges, stacked with melted American cheese on butter-toasted sesame buns with a tangy pickle special sauce, dill pickles, paper-thin onion, and shredded iceberg.

ingredients.name: ground chuck
ingredients.preparation: divided into 8 loosely formed 3-oz balls; not packed

ingredients.name: sesame-seed hamburger buns
ingredients.note: contain wheat and sesame; commercial buns commonly also contain milk, egg, and soy, all declared in allergens

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: softened; for toasting buns. Milk allergen.

ingredients.name: yellow mustard
ingredients.note: mustard is not a US major allergen and has no runtime token

ingredients.name: dill pickle chips
ingredients.note: about 20 chips plus 1 tsp brine: 2 tbsp finely chopped for the sauce, the rest for topping
ingredients.preparation: 2 tbsp finely chopped; rest left whole

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: patties plus a pinch for the sauce

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: a thin film for the first batch

steps.title: Make the special sauce and toppings
steps.body: Finely chop 2 tbsp of the pickles. Stir together the mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, 1 tsp pickle brine, garlic powder, and a pinch of pepper. Shred the lettuce, slice the onion paper-thin, and set out the remaining pickle chips.

steps.title: Portion the beef and butter the buns
steps.body: Divide the chuck into 8 loosely formed 3-oz balls without packing or kneading; keep them on a plate in the refrigerator until the pan is hot. Spread the softened butter on the cut sides of the buns. Cut 8 small squares of parchment for pressing.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.body: Heat a 12-inch cast-iron skillet (or griddle) over medium-high until very hot, about 4 minutes; a drop of water should skitter.

steps.title: Toast the buns
steps.body: Toast the buttered cut sides in two batches until golden, about 1 minute per batch. Transfer to plates and spread the special sauce on both halves. Wipe the skillet with a paper towel.

steps.title: Smash and sear in batches
steps.body: Add a thin film of oil. Place 3 beef balls well apart in the skillet. Within the first 30 seconds, press each one hard with a stiff metal spatula (parchment square between) to about 1/4 inch thick with ragged edges. Season the tops with salt and pepper. Cook undisturbed until the edges are lacy and deep brown and only a little pink shows on top, about 2 minutes. Scrape under the crust with the spatula edge and flip. Lay a slice of cheese on each and cook 45 to 60 seconds. Stack each cheesy patty onto another to make doubles as they come off. Scrape out excess fat between batches and repeat in batches of 3, 3, and 2 (about 4 minutes per batch).

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Build each burger: sauced bottom bun, double patty with cheese, pickle chips, onion, shredded lettuce, sauced top bun. Serve immediately. kitchen_tested is false.
